title: Quantum kernels on breast data: concentration, surrogates, and two ways an advantage gets manufactured
abstract: arXiv:2611.32942v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum-kernel advantage claims on breast data are usually a single number: one quantum arm, one comparator, one test split. We asked what that number measures once the full comparator set and selection history are visible. We report three active benchmarks, all exact classical statevector simulations of 8-qubit fidelity kernels with no quantum component in the inference path: a sample-efficiency sweep on Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer at ten training-set sizes; raw-versus-processed arms on 1,200 M-SYNTH simulated mammograms with a matched closed-form dequantisation surrogate, five classical methods at the same input and eleven kernel families; and a 30-seed selection-inflation measurement on BreastMNIST. A CMMD D1 clinical arm is withdrawn as a result arm because its frozen splits leak the label through patient serial order, a defect reported in a separate study; it is retained only as a worked example. translated_title: 乳腺数据上的量子核：集中效应、替代模型以及量子优势被“制造”出来的两种方式
translated_abstract: 量子核方法在乳腺数据上的优势宣称通常只是一个孤立的数字：一个量子方案、一个对照方法、一个测试集划分。我们探究了当完整的对照方法集合和选择历史都可见时，这个数字究竟衡量了什么。我们报告了三个有效的基准测试，全部采用8量子比特保真度核的精确经典态矢量模拟，推理路径中不含任何量子成分：（1）在威斯康星乳腺癌诊断数据集上，以十个不同训练集规模进行的样本效率扫描；（2）在1,200张M-SYNTH模拟乳腺X线照片上进行的原始数据与处理后数据的对比实验，配有匹配的闭式去量化替代模型、相同输入下的五种经典方法以及十一种核函数家族；（3）在BreastMNIST数据集上进行的30个随机种子的选择膨胀测量。CMMD D1临床数据集的实验作为结果性实验被撤回，因为其固定的数据划分会通过患者序列顺序泄露标签——该缺陷已在另一项研究中被报告；该实验仅作为案例示例被保留。所有三个有效的实验方案都是n...（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文通过对乳腺癌数据上的量子核优势宣称进行系统性基准检验（涵盖样本效率扫描、闭式去量化替代模型对比和选择膨胀测量），揭示所谓的量子优势可能是由于不完整的对照比较、选择偏差乃至数据泄露而被“制造”出来的假象。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically benchmarks quantum-kernel advantage claims on breast cancer data, revealing that apparent quantum advantages can be manufactured artifacts of incomplete comparator sets, selection bias, and data leakage.
